content.user_title: Plan a Practical Home Dining Room
content.value_statement: Poor furniture sizing and storage choices can make a home dining room difficult to use. This skill uses Chinese renovation references to guide practical decisions.
actual_capabilities: Suggest dining layouts that prioritize circulation, furniture dimensions, and access to adjacent rooms.
Explain dining table material, sizing, chair clearance, and maintenance tradeoffs.
Compare sideboard storage layouts, drawer organization, appliance placement, and combined entrance cabinets.
Discuss banquette seating, bay window use, and compact dining arrangements.
Explain dining light positioning and coordination with tables, ceilings, and surrounding lighting.
Compare kitchen islands, beverage stations, and shared living and dining layouts using topic-indexed references.
limitations: The collection contains Chinese articles, duplicate material, extraction artifacts, and references to images that are not included.
Advice is qualitative and cannot replace site measurements, construction drawings, structural review, or qualified electrical and plumbing assessment.
The skill provides no live prices, product inventory, vendor verification, or automated purchasing.
Some material claims and dimensions are anecdotal or context-dependent rather than verified standards.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Renovation
use_cases.description: Identify dining table, storage, and lighting mistakes before buying furniture or ordering cabinets.
use_cases.target_user: Homeowners planning their first dining room renovation

use_cases.title: Compare Compact Dining Layouts
use_cases.description: Compare folding tables, banquettes, shallow cabinets, and combined storage while preserving essential circulation.

use_cases.title: Structure a Client Consultation
use_cases.description: Use the topic index to discuss dining storage, appliance integration, lighting placement, and renovation constraints.
use_cases.target_user: Residential interior designers and renovation consultants

prompt_templates.title: Identify Common Mistakes
prompt_templates.prompt: I am renovating a home dining room for [household size]. List common mistakes and practical alternatives. Ask for missing measurements before recommending furniture sizes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand priorities before choosing furniture.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Table Options
prompt_templates.prompt: My dining area measures [dimensions], with doors at [positions]. Compare round, rectangular, and folding tables for [people]. Include chair access and maintenance tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare furniture options for a measured space.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Dining Storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a sideboard for [wall dimensions] holding [items and appliances]. Compare freestanding and custom options. Flag appliance clearances and utility details requiring professional confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: develop a storage brief before ordering cabinets.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Integrated Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [layout description] for [household needs] and [budget]. Compare banquette, table, and island layouts. Cite relevant references and flag circulation, lighting, and construction constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate alternatives across connected living and dining spaces.

output_examples.input: My small dining area also connects the entrance and kitchen. Should I buy a larger table?
output: Avoid choosing a larger table before checking the route between the entrance and kitchen.
Measure the table footprint, chair pullout space, door swings, and remaining passage when people are seated.
Compare a compact table, a folding table, and a wall-side banquette before purchasing.
Confirm dimensions on site before selecting a specific table size.

output_examples.input: I want a sideboard for a coffee machine and refrigerator. What should I plan first?
output: Avoid ordering cabinets before selecting appliances and checking their installation instructions.
Confirm countertop depth, appliance ventilation, refrigerator door movement, and access for maintenance.
Separate cup and coffee storage into accessible drawers or cabinets.
Have a qualified electrician assess outlets and circuit capacity before installation.
Compare full-height cabinetry with a lower freestanding cabinet if the dining area feels crowded.

output_examples.input: My table is beside a wall, but the ceiling light is centered in the room. Is that a problem?
output: For table-focused lighting, assess alignment with the table rather than assuming the room center is correct.
Keep separate ambient lighting for circulation and the rest of the room.
Confirm the final table position before changing the pendant location.
Ask a qualified installer to assess fixture relocation and mounting.

best_practices: Provide room dimensions, door and window positions, household size, and daily dining habits before requesting layout advice.
Choose appliances before finalizing cabinets, and verify manufacturer clearance, ventilation, and installation requirements.
Treat article dimensions as starting points and confirm construction, electrical, plumbing, and structural decisions with qualified professionals.
anti_patterns: Copying a photographed layout without checking circulation, seating comfort, or the dimensions of your own room.
Prioritizing decorative cabinets or oversized furniture over storage needs and daily access.
Treating reference articles as permission to remove walls or modify utilities without professional review.

faq.question: Is this skill for commercial restaurants?
faq.answer: Its main content concerns residential dining rooms. It does not provide commercial kitchen, accessibility, fire, or restaurant compliance planning.

faq.question: What source material does it use?
faq.answer: It uses 72 Chinese reference articles organized by topic and publication date, plus a guide describing practical renovation priorities.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide room measurements, doors, windows, household size, budget, storage needs, and appliance models. Describe how you use the dining space.

faq.question: Can it produce construction-ready plans?
faq.answer: No. It provides suggestions and comparisons, not verified construction drawings, structural calculations, or professional installation approvals.

faq.question: Does it include the article photographs?
faq.answer: The supplied files are Markdown text. Many captions refer to photographs or animations that are not included.

faq.question: Does the skill need scripts or internet access?
faq.answer: The supplied skill consists of Markdown guidance and local reference files. It specifies no scripts, package installation, or required network service.
